title: Focused Mind (General Skill, level 25)
body:
Syntax: focused mind [on|off] | perform focused mind [on|off]
All classes learn this skill at level 25; teacher practice is required first. Activation costs 20 Chakra and 5 Stamina; cooldown 15 seconds. Duration is 60 seconds plus mastery percent. Improves hit chance by 5-10 percentage points depending on mastery for your normal attacks and offensive techniques in every class, against mobs and players. The bonus respects normal hit-chance caps and does not increase your clones or summons. Also shortens newly received ordinary Genjutsu status effects by 10-30% depending on mastery, including Nehan Shoja sleep. It stacks with existing Sharingan duration resistance and never grants immunity. While active, halves accuracy penalties from Confused, Narakumi, Soundless, Disoriented, Haze and Ringing. Does not shorten effects already applied, cancel action-blocking effects or prevent Mangekyo-specific powers. Each successful walking step costs 1 extra Stamina. Use aff for remaining duration.
